journey.name: loading toast long locale
journey.description:
A toast that does not hide by itself shows a close X at its top right, and its text never runs under that X. French makes the Pubky sign-in loading toast's title ("Chargement de votre profil Pubky") long enough to fill the first line on a device about 360 dp wide; the title wraps before the X instead of continuing beneath it.
Precondition: as pubky-auth/signin-cold-start.xml (an unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled, a locally managed Pubky identity, and a fresh pubkyauth://signin_grant URL), on a device about 360 dp wide, e.g. `adb shell wm size 1080x2400` and `adb shell wm density 480`. Airplane mode right after the link opens keeps the toast up long enough to inspect it.
Toasts are not in `android layout`, so every check here reads a screenshot.

actions.action: Run `adb shell cmd locale set-app-locales to.bitkit.dev --locales fr`
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "<the prepared signin_grant URL>"`, then `adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable`
Unlock Bitkit with PIN or biometrics when prompted
Verify from a screenshot that the toast titled "Chargement de votre profil Pubky" shows a close X at its top right
Verify from the same screenshot that no part of the title or description is drawn under or to the right of the left edge of the X
Tap the X and verify the toast closes
Run `adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode disable`
Run `adb shell cmd locale set-app-locales to.bitkit.dev --locales ''`
